highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
The University of Exeter, located in the stunning southwest of England, is one of the UK’s leading universities. The University was created in 1955 by the merger of St Luke's College, Exeter School of Science, Exeter School of Art and the Camborne School of Mines.

It’s a member of Russell Group’s research-intensive universities. The University has won the TEF Gold for teaching excellence while 98% of its research is of international quality, with 82% rated world-leading or internationally excellent.

It’s also in the top 20 UK universities, ranked in The Complete University Guide, The Guardian, and The Times/Sunday Times. It’s been the Sunday Times University of the Year and the Times Higher Education University of the Year in recent years.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value:
Student life at Exeter is vibrant and dynamic. The campus is a melting pot of cultures, with more than 25,000 students from over 130 countries.

From student societies to volunteer programs, you’ll find plenty of ways to get involved. The Students' Guild is the heart of student activities, organising events and offering support. You can choose from around 300 different clubs.

If you love sports, you can join the active Athletic Union that runs 52 sports clubs, covering activities from American Football to surfing.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Exeter offers a range of on-campus accommodation options, which is ideal for first-year students. The rooms are modern, well-equipped, and within walking distance of the academic buildings. There are various room types, from shared rooms to private studios, so you can choose what suits your preferences.

The university’s accommodation office provides lots of helpful advice and resources to help you find the right place to live, whether on or off campus. Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The University of Exeter’s library is filled with study spaces, thousands of books, e-resources, and quiet areas to help you study better. Plus, it’s open 24 hours during exam periods.

Sports
Exeter has many sports activities for you! Whether you’re into team sports like football and rugby or individual activities like tennis and rowing, you’ll find plenty of opportunities to get involved.

The Streatham Campus Sports Park is a key place, featuring tennis courts, a fitness centre, and even an outdoor adventure centre where you can take part in rock climbing and watersports. Exeter also has teams for a variety of sports, competing in the British University & College Sport (BUCS) league.

Laboratory
The University of Exeter boasts a range of cutting-edge laboratories and research facilities. Some key ones include the Environment and Sustainability Labs, the Life Sciences and Biomedical Labs, Engineering and Materials Science Labs, Physics and Astrophysics Labs, and many more.

Cafeteria
There are several cafés, dining halls, and food outlets scattered around the campus, so you’ll have a lot of options and places to eat. The Forum at the heart of the campus has several food stations. Plus, there’s the Streatham Court dining area, which serves international cuisines.
